title: Wiki freshness cost calibration profile
description: AFC-22/AC-22 (flow 236, phase 4, T10): the versioned latency budget, concurrency bound and ranking weights that a freshness-path optimisation must be checked against. Written from the requirement text (metrics-and-validation.md §M09/M05/22, wiki-specification.md §7, prd.md AFC-22) and this repo's own existing interactive-tool ceiling, BEFORE any batching/caching change lands — never fitted to a measured run. A later optimisation bumps `profileVersion` here first; it must not just get faster and leave this file silently stale.

profileVersion.description: Semver of this calibration profile, independent of the package version. Bump on any change to the numbers below, including a change made BECAUSE an optimisation landed.

derivedFrom.description: Requirement/doc anchors this profile's numbers were derived from, not measurements of the current implementation.

agreedBeforeOptimisation.description: AC-22's ordering clause, machine-checkable: this field can only be true, and its presence is the record that the profile predates any batching/caching code change on the freshness path.

scales.description: The page counts this profile is calibrated for. AC-22 fixes these at 50/500/2000.

perDistinctBaseRevision.description: Git subprocesses budgeted per distinct VerifiedAt base revision touched in a run, once pages sharing a base revision are queried in one batch (existence check + batched log + batched diff).

fixedPerRun.description: Subprocesses spent once per run regardless of page count or base-revision count (the up-front availability probe).

perPage.description: A degenerate corpus (every page on a distinct base revision, batching cannot help) must not exceed this many git subprocesses per page — i.e. batching must never regress the pathological case below today's linear baseline.

perScale.description: Keyed by page count (as a string, matching `scales`). Wall-clock target assuming typical base-revision clustering, NOT the worst case.

hardCeiling.description: An absolute ceiling at the largest required scale, in ANY corpus shape (including the degenerate no-shared-base-revision case), independent of the typical-case numbers above.

unitCostAssumptionMs.description: Machine constant (measured git-subprocess overhead on the reference host) used ONLY to translate the subprocess budget above into a wall-clock estimate for reporting. This is a unit-conversion input, not a target derived from the current implementation's behaviour.

outOfScope.description: Named deliberately NOT delivered by the task that wrote this profile, so a later optimisation is not credited with silently reading requirements this document never claimed.
